query: db.cells.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "year": 1 }, output: { moving_avg: { $avg: "$dropped_calls", window: { documents: [-2, 0] } } } } }, { $match: { $expr: { $gt: ["$dropped_calls", { $multiply: ["$moving_avg", 1.25] }] } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, tower: 1, dropped_calls: "$dropped_calls", moving_avg: 1 } }])
